sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: NVIDIA DeepStream 9.1 introduces 13 agentic skills that let coding agents like Claude Code and Codex build multi-camera video analytics pipelines from natural-language prompts. Multi-View 3D Tracking (MV3DT) fuses per-camera detections into one shared 3D world with a globally consistent object ID, while AutoMagicCalib (AMC) removes manual camera calibration. The release also adds JetPack 7.2 support and a unified open-source GitHub monorepo. The post NVIDIA Released DeepStream 9.1: Bringing Agentic AI to Vision AI With 13 Skills and Multi-View 3D Tracking appeared first on MarkTechPost .
